easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Vesuvan Doppelganger.
description:
Cast Vesuvan Doppelganger by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel
When Vesuvan Doppelganger enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
When Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Vesuvan Doppelganger. Choose to have Vesuvan Doppelganger enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 2.
